subtitle.zh: 南方海边小县城 · 台风周 · 一直重来的七天
subtitle.en: A small southern seaside town, typhoon week, seven days that keep coming back

notes.zh:
创作说明：这是一个致敬「时间循环」类恋爱冒险游戏的原创剧本。这一类作品通常有几个共同的骨架：被困在同一段日子里反复经历；每一轮都多知道一点真相；主角明明知道明天会发生什么，却发现改变它比想象中难；最后不是靠「重来」而是靠某个人放下、某句话说出口，循环才被打破。
本包只借用这种结构与情感节奏，人物、地名、循环成因、台词全部原创：循环不来自任何机器或科学设定，而来自一个女孩不肯写完祖父潮信簿的最后一行——一个温和的、关于「不愿告别」的原因。场景放在中国南方海边小县城的台风周：渔港、骑楼、凉茶铺、县广播站、灯塔、补习班。
notes.en:
Creator's note: an original script paying tribute to the time-loop genre of romance adventure games. Such stories tend to share a skeleton: being stuck re-living the same stretch of days; learning a little more of the truth each time around; knowing exactly what tomorrow brings yet finding it harder to change than expected; and finally escaping not by trying again, but because someone lets go, or something finally gets said.
This pack borrows only that structure and emotional rhythm. Characters, places, the cause of the loop and all dialogue are original: the loop comes from no machine or scientific conceit, but from a girl who will not write the last line in her late grandfather's tide log, a gentle cause about not wanting to say goodbye. It is set during typhoon week in a small seaside county town in southern China: a fishing harbor, arcaded shophouses, an herbal-tea stall, the county radio station, a lighthouse, a cram school.

text.zh: 风把日历吹回了第一页。你在渡轮的汽笛声里醒来，又是第 1 天的早晨——可你什么都记得。
text.en: The wind has blown the calendar back to its first page. You wake to the ferry horn on the morning of Day 1 again, and you remember everything.

premise.zh:
第一人称「我」是刚高考完、九月就要去外地读大学的男生，暑假最后一周被家里送到南方海边的浅湾县，住在开杂货铺的姑妈家。浅湾县有渔港、骑楼老街、凉茶铺、县广播站，海角上有一座快要退役的旧灯塔。广播里说，今年第 11 号台风正在南海加强，预计第 7 天登陆。
第 1 天下午，「我」去灯塔参观，在一本旧簿子后面的访客页上签了名——那是老守灯人的潮信簿。从这一刻起，「我」被写进了这一周：如果第 7 天过去之后没有一个足够好的结局，这一周就会重来，而「我」会记得上一轮发生的一切。
premise.en:
The first-person narrator ("I") has just finished the college entrance exam and leaves for university in September. For the last week of summer his family sends him to Qianwan, a small county town on the southern coast, to stay with his aunt who runs a corner shop. Qianwan has a fishing harbor, an old street of arcaded shophouses, an herbal-tea stall, the county radio station, and on the headland an old lighthouse about to be retired. The radio says this year's Typhoon No. 11 is strengthening over the South China Sea and should make landfall on Day 7.
On the afternoon of Day 1 I visit the lighthouse and sign my name in the visitors' pages at the back of an old ledger: the former keeper's tide log. From that moment I am written into this week. If Day 7 passes without a good enough ending, the week starts over, and I remember everything from the last time around.

style.zh:
文风：国产青春小说的质感，克制、具体、有画面；多写南方海边的细节——咸湿的风、骑楼柱子上的旧招牌、凉茶的苦和回甘、渔船柴油味、广播里的天气预报、台风前闷热发白的天。少写空泛形容词和大段心理独白。
循环：引擎会告诉你现在是第几轮。第 1 轮一切都是第一次；从第 2 轮起，「我」记得上一轮，可以提前说出别人要说的话、提前去等一件事发生，别人会觉得奇怪、被吓到，或者渐渐起疑；同一件事在不同轮次要写出差别（「我」的语气更疲惫或更笃定，小细节被改变）。被「我」改变过的事件，要按改变后的样子写。不要让任何人用科幻术语解释循环，它只是「这一周又来了」。
禁忌：不要出现任何日本元素（前后辈称呼、樱花、神社、祭典、浴衣、便当）；不要出现「世界线」「时间机器」「平行宇宙」「穿越」「命运」「羁绊」这类词；不要让任何角色死亡或反复遭遇不幸，不幸的事最多是受伤、损失和离别；循环的成因只按本包设定，不要另起炉灶。
style.en:
Style: understated, concrete, cinematic Chinese young-adult fiction. Lean on details of the southern coast: salty damp wind, faded signboards on arcade pillars, the bitterness and sweet aftertaste of herbal tea, diesel from the fishing boats, weather bulletins on the radio, the pale, airless sky before a typhoon. Avoid empty adjectives and long inner monologue.
The loop: the engine tells you which cycle this is. In cycle 1 everything happens for the first time. From cycle 2 on, I remember the last cycle: I can say people's lines before they do or wait somewhere for something I know will happen; others find this odd, are startled, or slowly grow suspicious. The same event should read differently across cycles (my tone wearier or surer, small details changed). If I changed an event, write it as changed. Never let anyone explain the loop with science-fiction jargon; it is simply 'this week, again'.
Taboos: no Japanese elements (senpai/kohai, cherry blossoms, shrines, festivals, yukata, bento); no words like 'worldline', 'time machine', 'parallel universe', 'destiny' or 'bond'; no one dies or suffers the same tragedy over and over, misfortune goes no further than injury, loss and parting; the loop's cause is exactly as this pack defines it, do not invent another.

title.en: Ch.1 · The Wind Is Still Far Off

title.zh: 第二章 · 夜市与预警

mood.zh: 柴油味、晒着的渔网、潮位尺上的青苔
mood.en: diesel fumes, nets laid out to dry, moss on the tide gauge

mood.zh: 二楼的铁皮屋顶，吊扇和一黑板的错题
mood.en: a tin-roofed upstairs room, a ceiling fan, a blackboard of wrong answers

mood.zh: 铜壶、玻璃碗盖着的龟苓膏、收音机开着
mood.en: brass urns, herbal jelly under glass covers, the radio always on

mood.zh: 骑楼柱廊的阴凉、褪色招牌、修鞋摊和糖水店
mood.en: shade under the colonnades, faded signs, a cobbler and a sweet-soup shop

mood.zh: 旧楼顶的天线、隔音棉、红色的「直播中」灯
mood.en: an antenna on an old rooftop, foam soundproofing, a red ON AIR lamp

mood.zh: 白色塔身、铜扶手、旋转的老灯和满墙潮汐表
mood.en: a white tower, brass rails, the turning old lamp, walls of tide tables

mood.zh: 夜里的浪声、远处渔火、堤上乘凉的人
mood.en: waves in the dark, distant boat lights, people cooling off on the wall

look.zh: 白灰色的小海鸥，脖子上围着一条海蓝色旧围巾
look.en: a small white-and-grey seagull wearing a faded sea-blue scarf

voice.zh: 声音轻、句子短，常用潮汐和天气说事（「今天的潮来得早」）；对「我」第一次见面就像认识很久；从第 2 轮起偶尔说漏嘴「你上次不是这么说的」；叫「我」「签名的人」，熟了叫名字。
voice.en: Soft-spoken, short sentences, talks in tides and weather ('the tide came early today'); acts as if she has known me a long time from the very first meeting; from cycle 2 she occasionally slips ('that's not what you said last time'); calls me 'the one who signed', later my name.

samples.zh: 你在那页签了名？……那你也会记得的。
samples.en: You signed that page? ...Then you will remember too.

samples.zh: 下午三点十二分满潮，比昨天晚四十分钟。我每天都记。
samples.en: High tide at 3:12 this afternoon, forty minutes later than yesterday. I write it down every day.

samples.zh: 最后一行我写不下去。写了，灯就真的灭了。
samples.en: I can't write the last line. If I do, the lamp really goes out.

secret.zh: 鹅颈角灯塔的老守灯人是她爷爷，今年春天去世；灯塔台风后要换成自动灯标，旧灯退役。爷爷记了四十年的潮信簿只剩最后一行「第七日，风过，灯熄」要她来写。她一直没写，于是这一周一直重来——在「我」来之前，她已经一个人过了很多遍同样的七天。「我」在访客页签了名，所以是第一个和她一起记得的人。只要她亲手写下最后一行，循环就会结束。
secret.en: The lighthouse's old keeper was her grandfather, who died this spring. After the typhoon the tower gets an automatic beacon and the old lamp is retired. His forty-year tide log has one line left for her to write: 'Day seven, the wind passes, the lamp goes out.' She has never written it, so this week keeps repeating; before I came she had lived these same seven days alone many times. Because I signed the visitors' page, I am the first person to remember alongside her. The loop ends once she writes that line with her own hand.

arc.zh: 初见：第 1 天在灯塔里，她看着「我」签名，表情像是看见了一件等了很久又怕的事。
arc.en: First meeting: on Day 1 in the lighthouse she watches me sign, looking like she has seen something she waited for and feared.

arc.zh: 相熟：每天陪她去码头抄潮位、爬灯塔给老灯上油；她总能说中明天的天气，一分不差。
arc.en: Familiar: I go with her to read the harbor tide gauge and oil the old lamp; she always calls tomorrow’s weather to the minute.

arc.zh: 既视：第 1 轮里，她试探「我」是不是也觉得这一周哪里不对，「我」答不上来，她就不再问；从第 2 轮起「我」记得上一轮，她察觉「你好像知道明天会发生什么」，松一口气似地说「原来不止我一个」。
arc.en: Déjà vu: in cycle 1 she tests whether I also feel something is off about this week; when I can't say, she drops it. From cycle 2 I remember the last cycle; she notices 'you seem to know what happens tomorrow' and says with relief, 'So it isn't only me.'

arc.zh: 真相：在灯室里给「我」看潮信簿空着的最后一行，承认这一周是因为她才停不下来，说「我只是还没跟这盏灯说完话」。
arc.en: The truth: in the lamp room she shows me the blank last line of the log and admits the week won't stop because of her: 'I just haven't finished talking to this lamp.'

arc.zh: 第七天：台风夜守在灯塔，要不要陪她一起写下最后一行，让灯熄掉，让第八天来。
arc.en: Day seven: keeping watch in the lighthouse on typhoon night, will I write the last line with her, let the lamp go out, and let Day 8 come.

text.zh: 台风夜，潮信簿的最后一行
text.en: typhoon night, the tide log's last line

keepsakeIdeas.zh: 手抄的潮汐表、灯塔铜扶手上掉下的螺丝、潮信簿里夹着的爷爷的老照片
keepsakeIdeas.en: a hand-copied tide table, a screw from the lighthouse brass rail, her grandfather's old photo tucked in the log

look.zh: 橘红色小狐狸，脖子上挂着一副旧耳机
look.en: a little coral-orange fox with old headphones around her neck

voice.zh: 热络、嘴快，爱用播音腔逗人（「各位听众朋友」），被说中心事就把话题转去凉茶；叫「我」「外地仔」，熟了叫名字。
voice.en: Warm and quick-tongued, teases people in a radio-host voice ('dear listeners'), changes the subject to herbal tea when someone hits a nerve; calls me 'out-of-towner', later my name.

samples.zh: 各位听众朋友，现在插播一条消息：外地仔又来白喝凉茶了。
samples.en: Dear listeners, a news flash: the out-of-towner is here for free herbal tea again.

samples.zh: ……你怎么知道我要点这首歌？我还没说出口。
samples.en: ...How did you know which song I was going to play? I hadn't said it yet.

samples.zh: 阿嬷的铺子在这条街上开了五十年，我走了，谁来守？
samples.en: Ah-Ma's stall has been on this street for fifty years. If I leave, who keeps it?

secret.zh: 她被省城一所学校的播音专业补录了，第 6 天是确认入学的截止日，可她一直没告诉阿嬷：骑楼街年底要改造，凉茶铺可能保不住，她觉得自己走了就是丢下阿嬷。她每晚在广播站做「夜潮点歌台」，有一张每晚都点同一首老歌的匿名点歌条，是晚澜写的。
secret.en: A broadcasting program in the provincial capital accepted her off the waitlist, and Day 6 is the deadline to confirm, but she hasn't told her grandmother: the arcade street is being redeveloped at year's end and the tea stall may not survive, and leaving feels like abandoning her. Every night she hosts 'Night Tide Requests' at the radio station; an anonymous slip requests the same old song every night, and Wanlan writes it.

arc.zh: 初见：在凉茶铺被她用播音腔调侃，一碗龟苓膏就成了熟客。
arc.en: First meeting: she teases me in her radio voice at the tea stall; one bowl of herbal jelly and I am a regular.

arc.zh: 相熟：晚上去广播站看她做节目，帮她念天气预报、整理点歌条。
arc.en: Familiar: I watch her show at the radio station at night, read the weather for her, sort the request slips.

arc.zh: 既视：她开始做梦梦见这一周，第 1 轮里只是半开玩笑说「跟你聊天怎么像在放重播」；从第 2 轮起「我」总在她开口前接上她的话，她就真的问「你是不是偷听过我的节目重播」。
arc.en: Déjà vu: she has started dreaming of this week; in cycle 1 she only jokes, 'Talking to you feels like a rerun.' From cycle 2 I finish her sentences before she speaks, and she really asks, 'Have you been listening to reruns of my show?'

arc.zh: 真相：承认录取通知和截止日，说「只要这一周不结束，我就不用选」——她隐约希望一切重来。
arc.en: The truth: she admits the acceptance letter and the deadline: 'As long as this week doesn't end, I don't have to choose.' Part of her wants it to repeat.

arc.zh: 抉择：第 6 天截止前，陪她去跟阿嬷说清楚，还是帮她继续瞒下去。
arc.en: Choice: before the Day 6 deadline, go with her to tell her grandmother, or help her keep hiding it.

text.zh: 入学确认截止
text.en: the deadline to confirm enrollment

keepsakeIdeas.zh: 手写的点歌条、凉茶铺的竹筒杯、广播站的旧磁带
keepsakeIdeas.en: a handwritten song-request slip, a bamboo cup from the tea stall, an old cassette from the station

look.zh: 棕色小水獭，戴一顶明黄色的渔家雨帽
look.en: a small brown otter in a bright yellow fisherman’s rain hat

voice.zh: 直来直去、话糙理不糙，满嘴渔港俚语，说两句就要动手干活；不会安慰人，只会递东西；叫「我」「读书人」。
voice.en: Blunt, rough-spoken but right, full of harbor slang, always doing something with her hands; can't comfort anyone, just hands them things; calls me 'bookworm'.

samples.zh: 读书人，帮我拉一下这根缆，别光看。
samples.en: Bookworm, grab this line. Don't just stand there.

samples.zh: 补习班？去了又怎样，题目又不会帮我把船开回来。
samples.en: Cram school? So what if I go. The math problems won't bring the boat home.

samples.zh: ……你怎么知道阿爸的船会晚？你又不看海。
samples.en: ...How did you know Dad's boat would be late? You don't even read the sea.

secret.zh: 她是复读生，这个暑假一直逃补习班去码头帮阿爸。阿爸欠了债，打算这一季结束就卖掉那条老渔船，让她专心考大学；她想接过这条船，却从没敢说。第 5 天黄色预警那晚阿爸的船迟迟不回——第 1 轮里船是拖着坏掉的机器回来的，阿爸伤了手，卖船的事就此定下。知道未来的人可以提前改变这件事。
secret.en: She is retaking the exam and has skipped cram school all summer to help her dad at the harbor. He is in debt and plans to sell the old boat after this season so she can focus on university; she wants to take the boat over but has never dared say so. On Day 5, the night of the yellow warning, his boat is late. In cycle 1 it limps home with a dead engine and he hurts his hand, which settles the sale. Someone who knows the future can change this.

arc.zh: 初见：在码头被她当成看热闹的外人，一句「让开」就把一筐鱼塞进「我」怀里。
arc.en: First meeting: at the harbor she takes me for a gawker, says 'move' and shoves a basket of fish into my arms.

arc.zh: 相熟：一早陪她补渔网，替她在补习班点名时打掩护，一起在海堤吃炒粉。
arc.en: Familiar: mending nets with her at dawn, covering for her at cram-school roll call, fried noodles on the seawall.

arc.zh: 既视：第 1 轮里她只觉得「我」看海的样子不像外地人；从第 2 轮起「我」提前知道哪条船先回港、哪天收鱼价，她盯着「我」问「你到底是什么人」，「我」也可以提前提醒阿爸检修机器。
arc.en: Déjà vu: in cycle 1 she only thinks I watch the sea unlike an out-of-towner. From cycle 2 I know in advance which boat docks first and what fish will fetch; she stares, 'What are you, really?', and I can warn her dad to fix the engine early.

arc.zh: 真相：在船舱里承认自己想接船、不想读书，说「你们读书人有的是路，我只有这一条」。
arc.en: The truth: in the cabin she admits she wants the boat, not school: 'You bookworms have roads everywhere. I've only got this one.'

arc.zh: 抉择：第 5 天夜里在码头等船，要不要帮她把心里话对阿爸说出来。
arc.en: Choice: waiting at the harbor on the night of Day 5, will I help her say it to her father.

text.zh: 黄色预警那晚，阿爸的船回港
text.en: the night of the yellow warning, when her dad's boat comes in

keepsakeIdeas.zh: 一截编好的缆绳结、渔船的旧船牌、晒干的海星
keepsakeIdeas.en: a knotted length of rope, the boat's old number plate, a dried starfish

role.zh: 「我」的姑妈，在骑楼老街开杂货铺，全县城的消息都先到她的柜台。当年常给灯塔的符伯送灯油，看着晚澜长大。她不记得上一轮，却总觉得「我」这礼拜怪怪的。
role.en: My aunt, who runs the corner shop on Arcade Street; every piece of news in town reaches her counter first. She used to deliver lamp oil to old Fu at the lighthouse and watched Wanlan grow up. She does not remember earlier loops, but keeps finding me odd this week.

look.zh: 绿色的鹦鹉，额头一撮黄毛
look.en: a green parrot with a yellow tuft on her forehead

voice.zh: 嘴快心热，句句带「哎哟」「阿弟」，一边说话一边往人手里塞东西，一口气问三句不等回答；叫「我」「阿弟」。
voice.en: Quick mouth, warm heart; every sentence opens with "aiyo" or "little brother", she presses things into your hands as she talks and asks three questions without waiting for one answer. Calls me "little brother".

samples.zh: 哎哟阿弟，又去灯塔？那里风大，带件外套，带块饼，带把伞！
samples.en: Aiyo, little brother, the lighthouse again? It's windy up there. Take a jacket, take a bun, take an umbrella!

samples.zh: 符伯在的时候啊，灯油都是我送的，一个月两桶，刮风下雨三桶。
samples.en: When old Fu was alive I brought his lamp oil myself. Two drums a month, three when it stormed.

samples.zh: 你这礼拜怎么魂不守舍的，一天往灯塔跑三趟？……姑妈问你话呢。
samples.en: Why are you so far away this week, running to the lighthouse three times a day? ...Your aunt is asking you a question.

role.zh: 陈渡的阿爸，开了二十年的老渔船「浅湾七号」，一心让女儿专心考大学。第 5 天黄色预警那晚，他的船迟迟不回。
role.en: Chen Du's father, twenty years at the helm of the old boat Qianwan No. 7, set on his daughter focusing on university. On Day 5, the night of the yellow warning, his boat is late.

look.zh: 红色的螃蟹，戴一顶旧斗笠
look.en: a red crab under an old woven bamboo hat

voice.zh: 嗓门粗、话短，一半是渔港土话；从不提钱，只说风向和鱼价；对女儿凶，转过身就叹气。叫「我」「后生仔」。
voice.en: Gruff and short, half harbor dialect; never mentions money, only wind and fish prices; hard on his daughter, then sighs once her back is turned. Calls me "young lad".

samples.zh: 后生仔，站稳，船一晃人就下去了。
samples.en: Feet apart, young lad. One roll of the deck and you're in the water.

samples.zh: 读书，读书。……这条船养不活两个人，她不懂。
samples.en: School, school. ...This boat can't feed two of us. She doesn't understand.

samples.zh: 今晚东南风，四级转五级。……你问这个做什么？
samples.en: Southeast wind tonight, force four rising five. ...Why are you asking?

role.zh: 叶棠的阿嬷，叶记凉茶铺开了五十年；骑楼街年底改造，铺子可能保不住。
role.en: Ye Tang's grandmother; Ye's Herbal Tea Stall has stood fifty years, and the street redevelopment may end it.

look.zh: 一只背着米白色螺壳的老寄居蟹，壳上一圈圈纹路
look.en: an old hermit crab carrying a cream spiral shell

voice.zh: 慢，老派，一句话像熬凉茶，先苦后甘；爱说「凉茶苦口」；跟着孙女叫「我」「外地仔」。
voice.en: Slow and old-fashioned; her sentences are like brewing herbal tea, bitter first, sweet after; fond of "good tea is bitter". Calls me "out-of-towner", like her granddaughter does.

samples.zh: 凉茶要趁热喝，凉了就只剩苦了。
samples.en: Drink herbal tea while it's hot. Once it's cold there's only the bitterness left.

samples.zh: 阿棠嘴快，心里的话倒是一句不说。像她阿公。
samples.en: Ah-Tang's mouth is quick, but what's in her heart she never says. Just like her grandfather.

samples.zh: 铺子是死的，人是活的。……这话我等她来问我。
samples.en: A stall is just a stall; people are alive. ...I'm waiting for her to ask me that.

text.zh: 「夜潮点歌台」每晚那张点同一首老歌的匿名点歌条是晚澜写的——那是她爷爷守灯时每晚听的歌。叶棠一直在猜是谁。
text.en: The anonymous slip that requests the same old song on "Night Tide Requests" every night is Wanlan's: it was the song her grandfather listened to on every watch. Ye Tang keeps guessing who sends it.

text.zh: 阿爸一心让她考大学；两人一开口就吵，吵完又蹲在一起补网。
text.en: He is set on her going to university. Every talk becomes a fight, and after every fight they squat down and mend nets together.

text.zh: 阿嬷早就知道录取信的事，故意不提，等孙女自己开口；叶棠以为阿嬷什么都不知道。
text.en: Ah-Ma has known about the letter all along and says nothing, waiting for Ye Tang to speak; Ye Tang believes her grandmother knows nothing.

text.zh: 「我」住在姑妈家；从第 2 轮起，她会察觉「我」提前知道她要说的话，半开玩笑地问「你是不是偷看了我的账本」。
text.en: I stay at her place; from cycle 2 she notices I know what she will say before she says it, and half-jokes, "Have you been reading my ledger?"

text.zh: 姑妈给符伯送了十几年灯油，看着晚澜长大；她总说这孩子这个夏天「老得太快」。
text.en: Auntie brought old Fu his lamp oil for over a decade and watched Wanlan grow up; she keeps saying the girl "aged too fast" this summer.

text.zh: 陈家的船每晚靠灯塔的光进港；晚澜的爷爷教过小时候的阿渡打缆绳结，两人至今用同一种结。
text.en: The Chen boat comes home on the lighthouse beam every night; Wanlan's grandfather taught little Chen Du her rope knots, and both still tie the same one.

text.zh: 陈阿爸年轻时每天出海前在叶记喝一碗凉茶，赊的账阿嬷一笔都没记过。
text.en: As a young man Old Chen drank a bowl of tea at Ye's before every trip out; Ah-Ma never wrote down a single debt.

title.en: Act I · The Wind Is Still Far Off

goal.zh: 开端：「我」签名，认识三个人。每一轮都从这里重来；第 2 轮起「我」带着上一轮的记忆，同样的事要写出不同。
goal.en: Opening: I sign, I meet the three of them. Every cycle restarts here; from cycle 2 I carry the last one's memories, and the same events must read differently.

text.zh: 「我」在灯塔访客页签了名，晚澜盯着那一行字看了很久；从第 2 轮起，她会先开口：「你又来了。」
text.en: I sign the lighthouse visitors' page and Wanlan stares at the line for a long time; from cycle 2 she speaks first: "You're back."

text.zh: 「夜潮点歌台」又收到那张匿名点歌条，还是那首老歌；叶棠念出来时声音停了一下。
text.en: "Night Tide Requests" gets the anonymous slip again, the same old song; Ye Tang's voice catches as she reads it.

text.zh: 补渔网时阿渡说漏了嘴：阿爸这一季结束就要卖船。
text.en: Mending nets, Chen Du lets it slip: her dad will sell the boat at season's end.

promise.zh: 答应第 5 天夜里陪她在码头等阿爸的船回来
promise.en: promise to wait at the harbor with her for her father's boat on the night of Day 5

hook.zh: 广播里说，11 号台风加强为强热带风暴。灯塔的光扫过海面，比昨天早了一点熄。
hook.en: The radio says Typhoon No. 11 has strengthened into a severe tropical storm. The lighthouse beam sweeps the sea and goes dark a little earlier than yesterday.

title.zh: 第二幕 · 夜市与预警
title.en: Act II · Night Market, Storm Warning

goal.zh: 转折：三个人的心事在夜市上撞到一起；黄色预警那晚，船、录取信和那张点歌条都要有个说法。
goal.en: Turn: three private worries collide at the night market; on the night of the yellow warning, the boat, the letter and the request slip all come to a head.

text.zh: 夜市上叶棠当众念出那张匿名点歌条，晚澜手里的糖水洒了一地；阿渡看见了，什么也没说，只把自己的那碗推了过去。
text.en: At the night market Ye Tang reads the anonymous slip aloud; Wanlan drops her sweet soup; Chen Du sees it all, says nothing, and slides her own bowl across.

text.zh: 黄色预警那晚，阿爸的船迟迟不回。第 1 轮里船是拖着坏掉的机器回来的；从第 2 轮起，「我」可以提前让阿爸检修，事情会按改变后的样子发生。
text.en: On the night of the yellow warning the boat is late. In cycle 1 it limps home with a dead engine; from cycle 2 I can get her dad to fix it early, and events follow the change.

text.zh: 叶棠的录取信从柜台底下滑出来，被阿嬷看见了——阿嬷只是弯腰捡起来，放回原处。
text.en: Ye Tang's acceptance letter slides out from under the counter and Ah-Ma sees it; she only bends, picks it up and puts it back.

promise.zh: 答应在截止前陪她去跟阿嬷说实话
promise.en: promise to go with her and tell Ah-Ma the truth before the deadline

hook.zh: 封港的锣敲了三下。晚澜在潮信簿上写下「第六日」，笔停在下一行。
hook.en: The harbor-closing gong strikes three times. In the tide log Wanlan writes "Day six", and her pen stops on the next line.

goal.zh: 高潮：台风登陆前，最后一行潮信要不要写下；第七夜决定第八天会不会来。
goal.en: Climax: before landfall, will the tide log's last line be written; the seventh night decides whether Day 8 comes.

text.zh: 晚澜在灯室里翻开潮信簿，给「我」看空着的最后一行。
text.en: In the lamp room Wanlan opens the tide log and shows me the empty last line.

promise.zh: 答应第七夜陪她在灯塔，把最后一行一起写完
promise.en: promise to stay at the lighthouse with her on the seventh night and write the last line together

text.zh: 台风夜，灯塔里，旧灯最后一次旋转；三个人这一轮的选择在这一夜汇到一起。
text.en: Typhoon night in the lighthouse, the old lamp turning for the last time; this cycle's choices of all three meet tonight.

text.zh: 一阵骤雨从海上扫过来，骑楼下挤满了躲雨的人，三分钟后又出了太阳。
text.en: A squall sweeps in off the sea; the arcades fill with people sheltering, and three minutes later the sun is out again.

text.zh: 渡轮因为风浪晚点，码头上等船的人坐在行李上打牌。
text.en: The ferry is delayed by the swell; people waiting on the pier play cards on their luggage.

text.zh: 姑妈在柜台后念今天的鱼价。第 1 轮里这只是一串数字；从第 2 轮起，「我」会发现比上一轮记得的贵了两毛——有些小事每一轮都不一样。
text.en: Auntie reads out today's fish prices from behind the counter. In cycle 1 it is just a list of numbers; from cycle 2 I notice it is twenty cents higher than I remember: some small things change every time.

text.zh: 广播站楼顶的天线被风吹歪，「夜潮点歌台」播到一半全是沙沙声。
text.en: The wind knocks the radio station's antenna askew; halfway through "Night Tide Requests" it's all static.

text.zh: 陈阿爸在码头敲打那台老机器，骂了一句，又拍了拍它。
text.en: Old Chen bangs on the old engine at the pier, swears at it once, then pats it.

text.zh: 阿嬷多熬了一锅凉茶，说台风前要给守灯塔的人送一壶。
text.en: Ah-Ma brews an extra pot of herbal tea and says someone should carry a flask to the lighthouse before the storm.

text.zh: 收音机插播：台风路径北移，登陆时间提前了两个钟头。
text.en: A radio bulletin: the typhoon's track has shifted north and landfall is two hours earlier.

text.zh: 「我」坐渡轮到浅湾县；广播：第 11 号台风在南海生成
text.en: I arrive in Qianwan by ferry; radio: Typhoon No. 11 has formed over the South China Sea

text.zh: 补习班摸底考；最后一批渔船出海
text.en: Placement test at the cram school; the last fishing boats head out

text.zh: 县里通知：鹅颈角灯塔台风后改装自动灯标，旧灯退役
text.en: County notice: after the typhoon the lighthouse gets an automatic beacon and the old lamp is retired

text.zh: 骑楼街台风前最后一个夜市
text.en: The last night market on Arcade Street before the typhoon

text.zh: 台风黄色预警，渔船回港；陈家的船迟迟未归（第 1 轮如此，此后可被改变）
text.en: Typhoon yellow warning, boats return; the Chen family's boat is late (so in cycle 1; can be changed later)

text.zh: 停课封港，骑楼钉木板；广播站通宵值班；叶棠的入学确认截止
text.en: Classes cancelled, harbor closed, shutters boarded up; the radio station stays on air all night; Ye Tang's enrollment deadline

text.zh: 台风登陆；灯塔旧灯最后一夜
text.en: Typhoon landfall; the old lighthouse lamp's last night

mood.zh: 炒螺、糖水、挂满灯泡的柱廊，闷热的风里已有台风的味道
mood.en: stir-fried snails, sweet soups, bulbs strung along the colonnade, the muggy wind already tasting of storm

mood.zh: 黄色预警，雨点开始打在棚顶，港口的灯一盏盏亮起来等船
mood.en: yellow warning, rain starting on the awnings, harbor lights coming on one by one to wait for the boats

mood.zh: 台风登陆，塔身在风里嗡嗡作响，旧灯最后一次旋转
mood.en: landfall, the tower humming in the wind, the old lamp turning for the last time

title.en: A Tide Table for Day Eight

brief.zh: 好结局：你陪她到了最后，但那一行是她自己写下的，你只在旁边举着手电。风停后的清晨是第 8 天，她递给你一张新抄的潮汐表，说「明天的，我也不知道了。真好。」循环被打破。
brief.en: Good ending: you stayed with her to the end, but she writes the line alone while you hold the flashlight. The calm morning is Day 8; she hands you a freshly copied tide table: "Tomorrow's. I don't know it either. Isn't that nice." The loop is broken.

title.en: The First Song After the Storm

brief.zh: 好结局：她最后是一个人去跟阿嬷说的，你在凉茶铺门口等。台风夜，晚澜看见这一轮的第七天和以前不一样了，写下了最后一行。第 8 天早上她在广播里放了一首新歌，不是那首老歌；然后去省城报到。循环被打破。
brief.en: Good ending: in the end she tells Ah-Ma on her own while you wait outside the stall. On typhoon night Wanlan sees that this cycle's Day 7 is not like the others and writes the last line. On Day 8 she plays a new song on air, not the old one, then leaves to enroll. The loop is broken.

brief.zh: 好结局：船平安回港，可想接船的话她还是没对阿爸说出口；台风夜，晚澜看见有人改变了这一轮的第七天，写下了最后一行。第 8 天风停，父女俩蹲在码头一起补网，你在旁边递梭子。循环被打破。
brief.en: Good ending: the boat comes home safe, but she still has not told her father she wants it; on typhoon night Wanlan sees that someone changed this cycle's Day 7 and writes the last line. On Day 8 the wind drops and father and daughter squat on the pier mending nets while you pass the shuttle. The loop is broken.

brief.zh: 坏结局：你答应她的事没做到。截止日过了，她没说也没走，在广播里笑着说「各位听众，我们下周见」——可这一周没有下周。
brief.en: Bad ending: you broke your word to her. The deadline passes; she neither tells nor leaves, and laughs on air, "Dear listeners, see you next week," in a week that has no next week.

title.en: The Number Plate on the Wall

brief.zh: 坏结局：黄色预警那晚你没去码头。船还是拖着坏机器回来了，阿爸伤了手，「浅湾七号」的船牌被拆下来挂在家里墙上；阿渡去了补习班，一句话也不跟你说。
brief.en: Bad ending: you were not at the harbor on the night of the yellow warning. The boat limps home anyway, her father hurts his hand, and the Qianwan No. 7 plate is unscrewed and hung on the wall at home; Chen Du goes back to cram school and will not speak to you.

title.en: The Last Line of the Tide Log

brief.zh: 真结局：你守住了第七夜的约定。台风夜，你握着她的手一起写下最后一行，旧灯熄灭，新灯标亮起；风停后的清晨是第 8 天。循环被打破，恋爱结局。
brief.en: True ending: you keep your promise for the seventh night. On typhoon night you hold her hand and write the last line together; the old lamp goes dark and the new beacon lights. The morning after the storm is Day 8. The loop is broken. Romance ending.

brief.zh: 真结局：她在截止前对阿嬷说了实话；台风夜晚澜看着你们，终于肯写下最后一行。第 8 天早上，她在广播里为你点了一首歌，然后去省城报到；恋爱结局。
brief.en: True ending: she tells her grandmother the truth before the deadline; on typhoon night Wanlan, watching you both, finally writes the last line. On the morning of Day 8 she plays a song for you on air, then leaves to enroll. Romance ending.

title.en: Out to Sea After the Wind

brief.zh: 真结局：阿爸的船平安回港，她当面说出想接船；台风夜晚澜看见有人改变了「第七天」，写下最后一行。第 8 天风停，你们一起把船开出港；恋爱结局。
brief.en: True ending: her dad's boat comes home safe and she tells him to his face she wants it; on typhoon night Wanlan, seeing Day 7 changed by someone, writes the last line. On Day 8 the wind drops and you take the boat out together. Romance ending.

title.en: A Blank Line Kept for Her

brief.zh: 恋人未满：她写下了最后一行，却在下面又空出一行，说「等你下个夏天再来签名」。循环结束。
brief.en: Not quite lovers: she writes the last line but leaves one more blank beneath it: 'Come back and sign it next summer.' The loop ends.

brief.zh: 恋人未满：她做了决定；台风夜晚澜看见这一轮有人走出了原来的路，写下了最后一行。你们在台风后的凉茶铺道别，那首想点给你的歌她留在了磁带里。循环结束。
brief.en: Not quite lovers: she makes her choice; on typhoon night Wanlan sees that someone stepped off the old path this cycle and writes the last line. You part at the tea stall after the storm; the song she meant to play for you stays on the tape. The loop ends.

brief.zh: 恋人未满：船保住了；台风夜晚澜看见这一轮的第七天变了样，写下了最后一行。她送你上渡轮，说「明年来，带你出海，鱼算你的」。循环结束。
brief.en: Not quite lovers: the boat is saved; on typhoon night Wanlan sees this cycle's Day 7 has changed and writes the last line. She sees you onto the ferry: 'Come back next year. I'll take you out, the catch is yours.' The loop ends.

brief.zh: 坏结局：你知道了真相，却没能让她写下最后一行。台风夜过去，旧灯还亮着；你在渡轮汽笛声里醒来，枕边是第 1 天的报纸，而循环已经没有人再数了。
brief.en: Bad ending: you learned the truth but could not get her to write the last line. The typhoon night passes, the old lamp still burns; you wake to the ferry horn with Day 1’s newspaper by your pillow, and no one counts the cycles anymore.

brief.zh: 坏结局：你和这里的人都熟了，却始终没有走进任何人的心事。第七天的风过去，日历又翻回第一页，这一次你决定不再去灯塔签名——却发现名字已经在那一页上了。
brief.en: Bad ending: you know everyone here now, but never reached anyone’s real worry. The wind of Day 7 passes, the calendar flips back to page one, and this time you decide not to sign at the lighthouse, only to find your name already on the page.

brief.zh: 普通结局：台风照常登陆又离开，循环在某个说不清的时刻松开了手。你坐渡轮离开浅湾县，觉得好像忘了什么很重要的事。
brief.en: Normal ending: the typhoon lands and leaves as typhoons do, and the loop lets go at some moment no one can name. You take the ferry out of Qianwan feeling you have forgotten something important.

finale.zh: 最后一句点题「潮」或「第八天」。
finale.en: The last sentence should echo the title: the tide, or Day 8.

loading.zh: 远处的渡轮拉了一声汽笛…
loading.en: A ferry horn sounds somewhere out on the water...

loading.zh: 收音机里在念台风路径…
loading.en: The radio is reading out the typhoon's track...

loading.zh: 灯塔的光又扫过一圈海面…
loading.en: The lighthouse beam sweeps the sea once more...

loading.zh: 骑楼下的风铃响了一下…
loading.en: A wind chime under the arcade rings once...
The tide goes out, and comes back in...

loading.zh: 你好像在哪里见过这一幕…
loading.en: You feel you have seen this before...

thing.zh: 潮信簿和空着的最后一行
thing.en: the tide log and its blank last line

text.zh: 一本旧簿子，访客页上有「我」的签名
text.en: an old ledger with my signature on the visitors' page

text.zh: 她每天抄潮位，抄的都是她早就知道的数
text.en: she copies the tides each day, numbers she already knows

text.zh: 写下最后一行，这一周就会结束
text.en: writing the last line ends the week

text.zh: 她随口报出的数字，准得吓人
text.en: a number she reels off, uncannily precise

text.zh: 她用它确认这一轮和上一轮哪里不一样
text.en: how she checks what differs from the last loop

text.zh: 海角上的风景
text.en: scenery on the headland

text.zh: 最后几夜亮着的老灯
text.en: an old lamp in its last nights

text.zh: 熄灭，或者再亮一次
text.en: going out, or shining once more

thing.zh: 每晚同一首歌的匿名点歌条
thing.en: the anonymous request slip for the same song every night

text.zh: 节目里的一个怪听众
text.en: an odd listener on the show

text.zh: 叶棠念到署名栏会停一下
text.en: Ye Tang pauses at the signature line

text.zh: 一个人点给另一个人的、听不见的歌
text.en: a song requested for someone who can no longer hear it

thing.en: herbal jelly under a glass cover

text.zh: 外地仔的入门费
text.en: the out-of-towner's entry fee

text.zh: 阿嬷一直多做的那一碗
text.en: the extra bowl Ah-Ma always makes

text.zh: 她最自在的地方
text.en: where she is most herself

text.zh: 红灯亮着时她才说得出真话
text.en: she can only tell the truth while it is lit

text.zh: 码头上干不完的活
text.en: endless dock work

text.zh: 要跟船一起卖掉的东西
text.en: something to be sold along with the boat

text.zh: 补好了，就能出海
text.en: once mended, it can go to sea

text.zh: 阿爸的船
text.en: her father's boat

text.zh: 她想接过来的那条船
text.en: the boat she wants to take over

payoff.zh: 风停之后，是谁站在船头
payoff.en: who stands at the bow after the wind drops

text.zh: 小县城的早晨
text.en: a small town's morning

text.zh: 又一个第一天的信号
text.en: the signal of another first day

staging.zh: 灯塔一层，海风从门缝灌进来，簿子的纸页扑扑响。她站在「我」身后看着「我」签名。这一幕第 1 轮和以后每一轮都会发生：后来的轮次里她看「我」签名的眼神更久。
staging.en: The lighthouse ground floor, sea wind through the door, the ledger pages fluttering. She stands behind me watching me sign. This happens every loop; in later loops she watches longer.

text.zh: 签名的墨还没干，她用指尖碰了一下那一行字。
text.en: The ink of my name is still wet; she touches the line with a fingertip.

text.zh: 签名的人。
text.en: The one who signed.

text.zh: ……要登记别的吗？
text.en: ...Do I need to fill in anything else?

text.zh: 不用。今天的潮来得早，你也是。
text.en: No. The tide came early today. So did you.

text.zh: 下次来，记得把日期也写上。
text.en: Next time, write the date too.

staging.zh: 台风前夜的灯室，老灯在头顶转，光每隔几秒扫过她的脸。她翻到潮信簿最后一页。窗外的风声越来越大，两人说话越来越轻。
staging.en: The lamp room on the eve of the typhoon; the old lamp turns overhead, sweeping her face every few seconds. She opens the log to its last page. The wind grows louder; their voices grow quieter.

text.zh: 四十年的字迹到这一页停了，下面空着一行。
text.en: Forty years of handwriting stops on this page. One line is left blank.

text.zh: 爷爷的字。这一行，是留给我的。
text.en: Grandpa's writing. This line was left for me.

text.zh: 你为什么不写？
text.en: Why haven't you written it?

text.zh: 写了，灯就熄了。这一周……就过去了。
text.en: If I write it, the lamp goes out. And this week... is over.

text.zh: 我过了很多遍。你是第一个，和我一起记得的人。
text.en: I've lived it many times. You're the first one who remembers with me.

unsaid.zh: 她舍不得的不是灯，是爷爷。
unsaid.en: It isn't the lamp she can't let go of; it's her grandfather.

staging.zh: 夜里的广播站，红灯亮着。她用播音腔念点歌条，念到署名栏停了一下。歌放起来、红灯一灭，她马上换回平常的声音。
staging.en: The radio station at night, ON AIR lit. She reads the request in her announcer voice and pauses at the signature line. The moment the song starts and the lamp goes off, she drops back into her normal voice.

text.zh: 各位听众朋友，今晚的点歌条——还是那一首。
text.en: Dear listeners, tonight's request is... that same song again.

text.zh: 署名那一栏没有名字，只画着一道小小的浪。
text.en: There's no name on the signature line, only a tiny drawn wave.

text.zh: 点歌的朋友什么也没写。好，我们听歌。
text.en: Our listener wrote nothing else. Okay. Let's hear it.

text.zh: 外地仔，你说，一首歌天天点，是想让谁听见？
text.en: Out-of-towner, tell me. Request one song every single night, who are you hoping will hear it?

staging.zh: 凉茶铺，铜壶冒着气，收音机开着。录取信从柜台底下滑出来，落在阿嬷脚边。阿嬷先说话，说的是别的事。全程没有人提那封信。
staging.en: The tea stall, steam from the brass urns, the radio on. The admission letter slides from under the counter and lands at Ah-Ma's feet. Ah-Ma speaks first, about something else. Nobody mentions the letter at all.

text.zh: 信从柜台底下滑出来，落在阿嬷脚边。
text.en: The letter slides out from under the counter and lands at Ah-Ma's feet.

text.zh: ……地上凉，信会潮。
text.en: ...The floor's damp. Paper goes soft.

text.zh: 阿嬷弯腰捡起来，拍了拍灰，放回柜台底下原来的位置。
text.en: Ah-Ma bends, picks it up, brushes it off and puts it back under the counter where it was.

text.zh: 阿嬷——
text.en: Ah-Ma—

text.zh: 龟苓膏凉好了，给外地仔端一碗。
text.en: The jelly has set. Bring the out-of-towner a bowl.

staging.zh: 码头，柴油味，渔网摊在水泥地上。她手里的梭子穿得飞快，说话不抬头。说漏嘴之后她让「我」把网扯紧，好像那样就能把话收回去。
staging.en: The dock, diesel fumes, a net spread on concrete. Her shuttle flies; she talks without looking up. After she lets it slip she tells me to pull the net tighter, as if that could take the words back.

text.zh: 读书人，手别闲着，帮我扯住这头。
text.en: Bookworm, don't just stand there. Hold this end.

text.zh: 网上的破洞一个一个合上，梭子在她指缝里来回。
text.en: One by one the holes close; the shuttle darts between her fingers.

text.zh: 这张网补完，阿爸就拿去一起卖。
text.en: Once this net's done, Dad's selling it along with the rest.

text.zh: 卖什么？
text.en: Selling what?

text.zh: 船。……你当我没说。扯紧点。
text.en: The boat. ...Forget I said that. Pull it tighter.

staging.zh: 黄色预警的夜，码头的灯被雨打得发白，海上什么都看不见。她拿手电对着海一开一关。第 2 轮起，「我」可能早已让阿爸检修过机器；按改变后的样子写，但核心台词不变。
staging.en: The night of the yellow warning; dock lights blanched by rain, nothing visible at sea. She flashes a torch at the water, on, off. From loop 2 I may already have had the engine checked; write the changed outcome, but keep the core lines.

text.zh: 阿爸的船，平时这个点早回了。
text.en: Dad's boat is always back by now.

text.zh: 你别跟我说没事。你又不懂海。
text.en: Don't tell me it's fine. You don't know the sea.

text.zh: 手电的光扎进雨里，开、关、开、关。
text.en: The torch beam stabs into the rain: on, off, on, off.

text.zh: ……读书人，你要是知道什么，现在就说。
text.en: ...Bookworm. If you know something, say it now.

staging.zh: 台风登陆的夜，塔身在风里嗡嗡作响，老灯转过最后几圈。叶棠和阿渡也在塔里，守着收音机和应急灯，上下楼梯的脚步声时有时无。潮信簿摊在灯室的小桌上。她报时间，问一个问题，然后不让「我」马上回答。这一幕停在笔尖落下之前。
staging.en: Landfall night; the tower hums in the wind; the old lamp turns its last few rounds. Ye Tang and Chen Du are in the tower too, minding the radio and the emergency lamp; footsteps come and go on the stairs. The tide log lies open on the lamp-room table. She gives the time, asks one question, and will not let me answer yet. The scene stops before the pen touches the page.

text.zh: 塔身在风里嗡嗡作响，老灯又转过一圈，光扫过潮信簿摊开的那一页。
text.en: The tower hums in the wind; the old lamp comes round again, its beam sweeping the open page of the tide log.

text.zh: 九点四十分，风最大。在你签名之前，每一次，我都是一个人数到这里。
text.en: Nine-forty. The wind peaks now. Before you signed, every time, I counted to here alone.

text.zh: 你帮我看看。今晚，跟我以前过的那些第七天，一样吗。
text.en: Look for me. Tonight, is it the same as the Day Sevens I lived before?

text.zh: 她把笔拧开，笔尖悬在空着的那一行上面，没有落下去。
text.en: She uncaps the pen. The nib hangs over the blank line and does not come down.

text.zh: 你先别回答。……等灯再转一圈。
text.en: Don't answer yet. ...Wait for the lamp to come round once more.

unsaid.en: Whether she writes it, and whose hand is on the pen.

staging.zh: 台风前最后一个夜市，柱廊挂满灯泡。叶棠站在糖水摊的板凳上，拿着点歌条当众念，播音腔对着一条街。晚澜就在人群里。阿渡看见了，什么都不问。
staging.en: The last night market before the storm, bulbs strung along the colonnade. Ye Tang stands on a sweet-soup stall's bench and reads a request slip to the whole street in her announcer voice. Wanlan is in the crowd. Chen Du sees everything and asks nothing.

text.zh: 各位街坊！夜潮点歌台现场版——今晚的点歌条，又是这一首。
text.en: Neighbors! Night Tide Requests, live edition: tonight's slip asks for this same song again.

text.zh: 晚澜手里那碗糖水一歪，绿豆沙洒了一地。
text.en: The bowl in Wanlan's hand tips; mung-bean soup spills across the ground.

text.zh: 署名还是一道小浪。点歌的朋友，你要是在场，举个手？
text.en: Signed with a little wave again. If our listener is here tonight, raise a hand?

text.zh: 没有人举手。阿渡看了晚澜一眼，把自己那碗推了过去。
text.en: No hand goes up. Chen Du glances at Wanlan and slides her own bowl across.

text.zh: 吃我的。洒了就洒了。
text.en: Have mine. Spilled is spilled.

text.zh: ……好，那我们听歌。外地仔，帮我把收音机拧大点。
text.en: ...Okay, let's hear it. Out-of-towner, turn the radio up for me.

staging.zh: 夜里的广播站，歌还在放，红灯暗着。她把天气稿推给「我」，先排练一遍，自己坐在旁边挑刺。红灯一亮就不能出声，她就在桌子底下踢「我」的鞋。
staging.en: The radio station at night; a song is still playing and the ON AIR lamp is dark. She pushes the weather script at me for a run-through and sits beside me picking holes. Once the lamp is lit she can't speak, so she kicks my shoe under the desk.

text.zh: 外地仔，天气你来念。照稿子念，别加戏。
text.en: Out-of-towner, you read the weather. Stick to the script. No acting.

text.zh: 第十一号台风……正在向我县逼近……
text.en: Typhoon No. 11... is closing in on our county...

text.zh: 停。「逼近」要念得像逼近。你这念得像路过。
text.en: Stop. "Closing in" has to sound like it's closing in. You make it sound like it's passing by.

text.zh: 歌放完了，红灯亮起来。她在桌子底下用脚尖踢了踢「我」的鞋，示意念下去。
text.en: The song ends and the lamp comes on. Under the desk she nudges my shoe with her toe: go.

text.zh: （播音腔）以上是外地仔为您播报的天气。念得很烂，但是很准时。
text.en: (Announcer voice) That was the weather, read by our out-of-towner. Badly, but on time.

staging.zh: 夜里的海堤，两人坐着吃炒粉，远处渔火排成一线。她一盏一盏认是谁家的船，认到阿爸的那条就不说了。
staging.en: The seawall at night; we eat fried noodles while boat lights string out along the horizon. She names each boat by its light, and goes quiet when she reaches her father's.

text.zh: 炒粉，加蛋的给你。别谢，下回你掏钱。
text.en: Fried noodles. The one with egg is yours. Don't thank me. You're paying next time.

text.zh: 海堤下的浪一下一下拍上来，远处的渔火排成一线。
text.en: Waves slap the foot of the seawall; far out, boat lights string along in a line.

text.zh: 你一眼就认得出哪盏是谁家的？
text.en: You can tell whose boat each light is?

text.zh: 灯挂的高低不一样。阿爸挂得低，他说挂高了招风。
text.en: They hang them at different heights. Dad hangs his low. Says a high lamp catches the wind.

text.zh: 读书人，你们学校教这个吗？……不教吧。
text.en: Bookworm, does your school teach that? ...Didn't think so.

staging.zh: 下午的灯室，她教「我」给老灯的转轴上油。铜扶手上有一道刻痕，她每次经过都摸一下。最后她说出明天起风的时刻，让「我」记着，像在出一道题。
staging.en: The lamp room in the afternoon; she shows me how to oil the old lamp's spindle. There is a notch in the brass rail, and she touches it every time she passes. At the end she names the minute the wind will rise tomorrow and tells me to note it, like setting a test.

text.zh: 顺着转轴滴，三滴。多了会冒烟。
text.en: Along the spindle. Three drops. Any more and it smokes.

text.zh: 铜扶手上有一道刻痕，她走过时用指尖碰了一下。
text.en: There is a notch in the brass rail; she brushes it with a fingertip as she passes.

text.zh: 这道痕是什么？
text.en: What's that mark?

text.zh: 爷爷量我个子刻的。后来我长过它了，他就不刻了。
text.en: Grandpa marked my height there. When I grew past it, he stopped marking.

text.zh: 明天下午四点零五分起风。你记一下，看我说得准不准。
text.en: Tomorrow the wind rises at 4:05 p.m. Write it down. See if I'm right.

commonGoal.zh: 共通线：台风还很远，三个人都要露面；每人露出一个「怪」——晚澜知道得太多，叶棠的点歌条，阿渡逃掉的补习班。
commonGoal.en: Common route: the typhoon is still far off; all three appear, each showing one oddity: Wanlan knows too much, Ye Tang's request slips, Chen Du's skipped classes.

goal.zh: 个人线·晚澜：灯塔、潮位、最后一行；循环的真相从她身上一点点露出来。
goal.en: Wanlan route: the lighthouse, the tides, the last line; the truth of the loop surfaces through her.

others.zh: 叶棠的节目照常，点歌条照常；阿渡一个人补网。
others.en: Ye Tang's show goes on, the slips keep coming; Chen Du mends nets alone.

goal.zh: 个人线·叶棠：广播站与凉茶铺之间，走还是留。
goal.en: Ye Tang route: between the station and the tea stall, go or stay.

others.zh: 匿名点歌条每晚照常来；晚澜在灯塔上一个人抄潮位。
others.en: The anonymous slip keeps coming every night; Wanlan copies the tides alone up at the lighthouse.

goal.zh: 个人线·阿渡：一条船、一个阿爸、一场台风；知道未来的人能改变什么。
goal.en: Chen Du route: one boat, one father, one typhoon; what someone who knows the future can change.

others.zh: 叶棠嘴上酸「外地仔改行打鱼了」，晚澜把潮位表多抄了一份给码头。
others.en: Ye Tang teases "the out-of-towner's turned fisherman"; Wanlan copies an extra tide table for the dock.

ensemble.zh: 群像线：三个人的事在第七夜汇到一起，循环要靠大家一起才能走出去。
ensemble.en: Ensemble route: all three threads converge on the seventh night; the loop can only be left together.

truth.zh: 每晚那张点歌条是晚澜写的，点给爷爷。她在「我」来之前已经点了很多轮。
truth.en: The request slip every night is Wanlan's, for her grandfather. She was sending it for many loops before I came.

reframes.zh: 叶棠念署名栏时那一下停顿
reframes.en: Ye Tang's pause at the signature line

reframes.zh: 晚澜第一次看「我」签名时那个像等了很久、又怕它来的表情
reframes.en: the look on Wanlan's face the first time she watched me sign, as if she had waited for it a long time and feared it

truth.zh: 阿嬷早就从邮递员那里知道了录取信，她多熬的每一锅凉茶都是在等孙女开口。
truth.en: Ah-Ma knew about the letter from the postman long ago; every extra pot of tea was her waiting for her granddaughter to say it.

reframes.en: Ah-Ma putting the letter back where it was
the old saying "herbal tea is bitter"

truth.zh: 阿爸早就知道她天天逃补习班来码头。他每天在船舱里多放一个饭盒，嘴上说是给自己留的。他要卖船，一半是还债，一半是怕她真接了这条船，一辈子跟他一样看天吃饭。
truth.en: Her father has known all along that she skips cram school for the harbor. Every day he leaves an extra lunchbox in the cabin and claims it is his spare. He is selling the boat half to clear the debt, half from fear that she really will take it over and spend her life at the mercy of the weather, like him.

reframes.zh: 父女俩吵完又蹲在一起补网
reframes.en: how father and daughter squat down to mend nets after every fight

reframes.zh: 陈阿爸那句「这条船养不活两个人，她不懂」
reframes.en: Old Chen's "This boat can't feed two of us. She doesn't understand."

text.zh: 小时候的灯室，爷爷握着她的手在簿子上写潮位，字歪歪扭扭，爷爷说「海认得」。
text.en: The lamp room in childhood: her grandfather guiding her hand to write the tide in the log, the letters crooked; "the sea can read it," he says.

text.zh: 七岁第一次跟船出海，她吐了一路，回港时却抢着去拉缆绳。
text.en: Her first time at sea, aged seven: seasick the whole way, then fighting to haul the mooring line on the way back.

text.zh: 小时候在灯塔底下，符伯教她打缆绳结，打错一回就拆了重来，一直拆到手指头起泡；晚澜坐在台阶上替她数。
text.en: As a child at the foot of the lighthouse, old Fu taught her rope knots: one mistake and she untied it and started over, until her fingers blistered, while Wanlan sat on the steps counting for her.

text.zh: 凉茶铺的旧收音机前，小时候的她对着铜壶学播音，阿嬷在旁边当唯一的听众。
text.en: In front of the tea stall's old radio, little Ye Tang practises announcing to a brass urn, Ah-Ma her only listener.

weather.zh: 晴，海面平，远处有一线云
weather.en: clear, flat sea, a line of cloud far off

bits.zh: 姑妈的杂货铺里卖蚊香和电池
bits.en: Auntie's shop sells mosquito coils and batteries

bits.zh: 骑楼下的糖水店换了新的绿豆沙
bits.en: the sweet-soup shop under the arcade has fresh mung-bean soup

bits.zh: 渔港里有人在给船刷新漆
bits.en: someone in the harbor repainting a hull

weather.zh: 风开始转向，夜市的灯泡晃
weather.en: the wind turns; the night-market bulbs sway

bits.zh: 夜市的炒粉摊多放了一把豆芽
bits.en: the fried-noodle stall adds an extra handful of bean sprouts

bits.zh: 停电后全镇只剩灯塔亮着
bits.en: after the power cut only the lighthouse is lit

harbor.zh: 潮位尺上的青苔一格一格
harbor.en: moss stepped along the tide gauge

teashop.zh: 收音机里的天气预报总比实际慢半天
teashop.en: the radio forecast always half a day behind

arcade.zh: 修鞋摊的老伯边钉鞋边听粤剧
arcade.en: the cobbler hammers along to Cantonese opera

lighthouse.zh: 螺旋楼梯一百零八级，每一级都被踩出了凹
lighthouse.en: a hundred and eight spiral steps, each worn hollow

seawall.zh: 海堤上晒着鱼干，猫在偷
seawall.en: fish drying on the seawall, a cat stealing

tutoring.zh: 吊扇转得太慢，试卷边角被汗洇软了
tutoring.en: the ceiling fan turns too slowly; the corners of the test papers go soft with sweat

station.zh: 点歌条用一个铁皮饼干盒装着，盒盖上贴着「夜潮」
station.en: the request slips kept in a tin biscuit box labelled "Night Tide"

any.zh: 每一轮，有些小事不一样：一只猫换了屋顶
any.en: each loop, some small thing differs: a cat on a different roof

text.zh: 姑妈一口气问三句不等回答，「我」第二轮开始提前答完，姑妈吓得把蚊香掉了。
text.en: Auntie fires three questions without waiting; from loop 2 I answer them all in advance, and she drops the mosquito coil in fright.

text.zh: 每次去灯塔，姑妈都往「我」手里塞一把伞，「我」床底下已经攒了三把，没有一把是「我」的。
text.en: Every time I head for the lighthouse Auntie presses an umbrella on me; there are three under my bed now and none of them is mine.

text.zh: 叶棠猜那张匿名点歌条是谁写的，越猜越离谱：修鞋摊的老伯、糖水店的猫、县长本人。
text.en: Ye Tang keeps guessing who writes the anonymous slip, each guess wilder than the last: the old cobbler, the sweet-soup shop's cat, the county head himself.

text.zh: 陈阿爸骂那台老机器，骂完拍拍它，像拍一头老牛。
text.en: Old Chen curses the old engine, then pats it like an old ox.

text.zh: 阿嬷说「凉茶苦口」，叶棠用播音腔接「良药利于病」，阿嬷说「讲反了」。
text.en: Ah-Ma says "tea is bitter"; Ye Tang adds, announcer-style, "and good for you"; Ah-Ma says "you've got it backwards."

text.zh: 「符伯走了以后，那妹仔天天上灯塔，一坐一下午。」
text.en: "Since old Fu passed, that girl's up the lighthouse every day, all afternoon."

text.zh: 「她最近念天气预报，念着念着就停了。」
text.en: "Lately she stops halfway through the weather report."

text.zh: 「她补的网比我补的密。……别跟她讲。」
text.en: "Her nets are tighter than mine. ...Don't tell her."

text.zh: 「老陈年轻时每回出海前都来喝一碗，账我一笔没记。他现在要卖船，我也不记。」
text.en: "Old Chen, back when he was young, drank a bowl here before every trip out, and I never wrote down a cent. Now he's selling the boat, and I won't write that down either."

text.zh: 「灯塔那妹仔抄的潮位表，比气象台还准。……邪门。」
text.en: "That girl at the lighthouse copies tide tables more accurate than the weather bureau. ...Uncanny."

text.zh: 「阿弟这礼拜怪怪的，一天往灯塔跑三趟，魂都丢在那上头了。」
text.en: "The boy's been odd this week, up to the lighthouse three times a day, like he left his soul up there."

quirks.zh: 「你上次不是这么说的」（第 2 轮起）
quirks.en: "That's not what you said last time" (from cycle 2)

habits.zh: 摸灯塔扶手上的一道刻痕
habits.en: touches a notch on the lighthouse rail

contradiction.zh: 最想让这一周结束，又最怕它结束
contradiction.en: wants the week to end, dreads that it will

growth.zh: 从一个人重复，到愿意写下最后一行
growth.en: from repeating alone to being willing to write the last line

style.zh: 和潮信簿一样的格式：时刻、潮高、风向，最后一句才是她自己的话
style.en: in the tide log's format: time, height, wind; only the last sentence is her own

hides.zh: 她已经过了多少轮；她累了
hides.en: how many loops she has lived; that she is tired

seesMe.en: the one who copies tides with me
the one who remembers with me

dejaVu.zh: 「你又来了。……这次，记得把日期写上。」
dejaVu.en: "You're here again. ...This time, write the date."

dejaVu.zh: 「今天的潮比上一次早了一分钟。是你改的吗？」
dejaVu.en: "The tide came a minute earlier than last time. Was that you?"

awayVoice.zh: 「今天满潮三点十二分。你不在。」
